Every day there is a fight for control of the {wiki:Poacher Caves}, in {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}, north of the Green Claw Swamp: on one side the wild animals, on the other the {creature:Poacher|Poachers} who hunt them — and, when the hunters overdo it, vengeful wolf spirits appear. Depending on who is in control, the caves have different creatures, and it is the players' actions that decide who wins.
the caves have several floors (down to -4)
There is no fixed reward: it is a hunting zone whose creatures change depending on the active variant.
Read the messages of the day (see table below) to know which variant is active before you go hunting.

The caves are at {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}, beneath the Orc Lands and north of the Green Claw Swamp. Go to the entrance shown. Ferngrims Gate is **northwest** of Venore, **east** of Kazordoon and southeast of Ab'Dendriel. The simplest way is to take the boat to **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and walk **northwest**, passing north of the Green Claw Swamp.
To leave, go back the same way to the entrance (go up with the {item:Rope} on the holes you went down) and walk back to Venore, to the **southeast**.
This mini world change is active **every day**. There are three possible versions of the caves, depending on who dominates.

It's a tug of war between the {creature:Poacher|Poachers} and the wild animals. **It depends on the players' actions** who wins and dominates the caves for a while. As the messages suggest: when the animals dominate, *"the hunters need some helping hands"*; when the poachers dominate, *"the animals need vengeful pals"*.
